name: idle
action: standing idle loop: panting happily with tongue out, tail wagging side to side, slight breathing, staying in place

name: walk
action: trotting walk cycle in place facing right, staying in the same spot, bouncy steps, ears and curly fur bouncing, tail up, loopable

name: run
action: fast gallop run cycle in place facing right, staying in the same spot, legs fully extending and tucking, ears flying back, loopable

name: bark
action: barking angrily forward to the right, front legs braced, mouth opening wide and snapping shut, body jolting with each bark

name: growl
action: territorial growl: lowers head, curly fur bristling, lips curled showing small teeth, tail stiff, body tense and trembling slightly

name: bite
action: lunges forward to the right and bites fiercely, jaws snapping shut, then pulls back to standing, small fluffy dog attacking

name: scared
action: cowers in fear: crouches low, ears pinned back, tail tucked between legs, trembling

name: hurt
action: gets bumped and yelps, flinches backward to the left with eyes squeezed shut, then recovers standing

name: sniff
action: sniffing the ground curiously, nose moving along the grass, tail wagging slowly

name: hop
action: playful jump straight up snapping at a butterfly above, front paws reaching up, then lands, staying in place

name: happy
action: sitting and being petted happily: eyes closing in bliss, tail wagging fast, head tilting up
